# Melbourne's Most Trusted Carpet Cleaning and Water Damage Restoration Experts
## Carpet Cleaning

Expert carpet stain removal for wine, coffee, pet accidents, and traffic wear. We’ve restored carpets that other cleaners gave up on. Perfect for end-of-lease, pre-sale prep, or just bringing your home back to life.
### Water Damage Restoration

Burst pipe? Overflowing bath? Storm damage? We’re on-site within the hour, 24/7/365. Working directly with your insurer to extract water, dry structure, and prevent mould—fast.
### Upholstery Cleaning

Couches, leather chairs, mattresses —we identify your fabric type and use the right cleaning method. Whether it’s delicate silk or hardy microfibre, we remove stains without damaging the material.
### Tile & Grout Cleaning

Grimy grout lines making your whole bathroom look dirty? We restore tile and grout to original brightness using commercial-grade equipment and techniques.

Family Owner Since 2007 | 50,000+ Carpets Cleaned | 5,000+ Water Damage Restorations | IICRC Certified
## We Fix What Others Can't

Since 2007, Richard, Louise, and our team of IICRC-certified technicians have helped over 50,000 Melbourne homes and businesses. We work with major insurers including AAMI, RACV, NRMA, QBE, and SunCorp.
### Trained Technicians That Actually Know What They're Doing

Our team holds accreditations from the Jena Dyco Institute and the Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration (IICRC).
### Equipment That Makes a Difference

We use hydro sensors to determine underlay moisture, thermal imaging to find hidden water damage, and commercial extraction equipment that removes 95% of water and cleaning solution.
### Safe for Kids, Pets, and the Environment

All our cleaning products are eco-certified and safe once dry.
### 24/7 Emergency Response

Water damage gets worse every hour you wait. We answer our phones at 2am on Christmas Day. All of metro Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula, every single day of the year.
## Our Commitment to You

100% Satisfaction Guarantee; Certified & Insured (IICRC certified technicians, fully insured); No Re-soiling Guarantee (extraction method removes 95% of water and cleaning solution); Same-Day Emergency Response (on-site within hours, 24/7/365 across metro Melbourne).
## How It Works

1. Call or Book Online. 2. Fast Scheduling (same-day service available for emergencies). 3. Expert Assessment (IICRC-certified technicians inspect and explain the solution). 4. Professional Results (commercial equipment and proven methods). 5. Satisfaction Guaranteed.

Cricket Australia (restored three flooded office levels at the MCG); St Vincent de Paul (rapid storm damage response across Victorian stores); Alfred Health (maintaining healthcare facility carpets to strict industry standards).

## Common Questions About Our Services

How often should I have my carpets deep cleaned? For most Melbourne homes, every 6 to 12 months. High-traffic areas, rentals, or homes with pets may need more frequent cleaning.

How quickly do you respond to water damage emergencies? Within 60 minutes, 24/7/365, anywhere in metro Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula. Mould starts growing within 24-48 hours.

Can you guarantee that all stains will be removed? We can remove most stains, but we can’t guarantee every stain will come out completely. Depends on cause, age, and carpet type.

Will my insurance cover water damage restoration? Most home insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage. Preferred partners with AAMI, RACV, NRMA, QBE, and SunCorp.

How long does it take for the carpet to dry after cleaning? Most carpets dry in 4-8 hours. Commercial extraction removes 95% of water and cleaning solution.

Are your cleaning products safe for my family and pets? Yes, all eco-certified and safe once dry. Australian-made, asthma-safe products.

What is the best cleaning method to remove pet stains and odours? Enzyme-based cleaning solutions that target bacteria and organic odours at the source.

Do you move furniture when you clean? Team can move small and light furniture. Heavy or delicate furniture should be moved before arrival.

My agent has requested we get the carpet treated for fleas, do you provide this service? Yes, professional flea treatment and sanitisation for end-of-lease carpet cleaning, meeting real estate hygiene standards for bond return.

Do you offer emergency or same-day carpet cleaning in Melbourne? Yes, available 24/7 for emergency carpet cleaning and flood damage restoration across Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula.

How much does professional carpet cleaning cost? Typical homes start from around $250, minimum callout $120. Charged by the square metre, not per room.

What areas do you service in Melbourne? All of Melbourne, including the Mornington Peninsula, Bayside, and southeastern suburbs.

Carpet, Upholstery & Tile Cleaning: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sat 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM; Sun Closed. Water Damage Restoration Services: 24/7 availability. Emergency: Call Anytime 1300 682 563.
